استطبن (form X)
# اِسْتَطَبْنَ (istaṭabna) /is.ta.tˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَطَابَ (istaṭāba)
# اُسْتُطِبْنَ (ustuṭibna) /us.tu.tˤib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَطَابَ (istaṭāba)
# اِسْتَطِبْنَ (istaṭibna) /is.ta.tˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَطَابَ (istaṭāba)
